questions.question:
Select the set in which the number are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operation should be performed on whole number; without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operation on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying, etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operation on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(162, 9, 18)

(231, 11, 21)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 2nd number × 3rd number = 1st number.

Now,

For, (162, 9, 18)

⇒ 9 × 18 = 162.

For, (231, 11, 21)

⇒ 11 × 21 = 231.

Similarly, for **(336, 28, 12)**

**⇒ 28 × 12 = 336.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the son of B'

A - B means 'A is the sister of B'

A × B means 'A is the mother of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the brother of B'.

Based on the above, how is P related to S if 'P × Q ÷ R - T + S'?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol

 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning

Given: P × Q ÷ R - T + S

It means: P is the Mother of Q, Q is the Brother of R, R is the Sister of T, T is the Son of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34242b9823c97ef3532ef636dd974886cf107162bd6abf7c7d99e43ff55fbe55.png] 

So, P is the 'Wife' of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged with '×' and '÷', respectively?

18 × 17 + 4 ÷ 22 - 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 18 × 17 + 4 ÷ 22 - 2 = ?

Now, if '+' and '-' are interchanged with '×' and '÷' respectively, then:

 
 

 **sign**
 +
 -
 
 

 **Interchanged**
 ×
 ÷
 
 

⇒ 18 + 17 × 4 - __**22 ÷ 2**__ = ?

⇒ 18 + __**17 × 4**__ - 11 = ?

⇒ __**18 + 68**__ - 11 = ?

⇒ __86 - 11__ = 75.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

In the given question it is given that **if '+' and '-' are interchanged with '×' and '÷', respectively**. Here the **word respectively** is given which means that** + is interchanged with '×'** and **'-' interchanged with '÷'. **

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'FLORENCE' is coded as '86' and 'GRATITUDE' is coded as '114'. How is 'FOREIGN' coded in the given language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of the place value of all numbers) + Number of letter in that word = Code of the word.

'FLORENCE' is coded as '86'

⇒ (6 + 12 + 15 + 18 + 5 + 14 + 3 + 5) + 8

⇒ 78 + 8 = 86.

'GRATITUDE' is coded as '114'

⇒ (7 + 18 + 1 + 20 + 9 + 20 + 21 + 4 + 5) + 9

⇒ 105 + 9 = 114.

Similarly, for '**FOREIGN**'

⇒ (6 + 15 + 18 + 5 + 9 + 7 + 14) + 7

⇒ 74 + 7 = 81.

So, 'FOREIGN' will be coded as '81'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ' ?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

15 ÷ 5 + 12 × 3 - 5 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 15 ÷ 5 + 12 × 3 - 5 = ? 

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 15 × 5 - __**12 ÷ 3**__ + 5 = ?

⇒ __**15 × 5**__ - 4 + 5 = ?

⇒ __**75**__ - 4 __**+ 5**__ = ?

⇒ __80 - 4__ = 76.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

‘all kings are beautiful' is coded as '42 63 mo ule'

questions.question: If 6 November 1925 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 16 December 1933?
questions.solution: Given: **6 November 1925** was Friday. Now, 1925 to 1933 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year). And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year. So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days, And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

questions.question: Four number pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)2 = 2nd number.

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) 15 - 225 → (15)² = 225. 

Option 2) 19 - 361 → (19)2 = 361.

Option 3) 9 - 81 → (9)2 = 81.

**Option 4) 4 - 64** → (4)2 = **16** ≠ 64.

So, '**4 - 64**' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pencils are cartoons.

All cartoons are rivers.

All rivers are shadows

**Conclusions:**

(I) All pencils are shadows

(II) All cartoons are shadows

(III) Some shadows are pencils.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some pencils are cartoons.

All cartoons are rivers.

All rivers are shadows

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c14cf344bddfbf20e3a4054fc1f539cefb60f1af838a1a0aa0187e47b27795cf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pencils are shadows - False (Because, some pencils are definitely shadows, but All pencils are shadows can be possible only).

II. All cartoons are shadows - True (Because, All cartoons are rivers and All rivers are shadows, this gives All cartoons are shadows).

III Some shadows are pencils - True (Because, those part of pencil which is cartoons will shadow also).

So, Both conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
